title: Posted
description: A series as it was posted: what the message that starts it says of it, as PROJECT/series/MESSAGE-ID/series.json (format/README.md).

schema.description: The format version the file follows (format/CHANGES.md)

message_id.description: The Message-ID of the series' first message, without <>, which names its directory

subject.description: The message's Subject, whole, with its prefixes, as [PATCH v2 0/5], and its blanks single

change_id.description: b4's change-id of the series, from the message's change-id: line; empty without one

revision.description: The vN of the subject's prefixes; 1 without one

text.description: The cover letter's text, as a commit's series.json keeps it in cover (series.schema.json): the body up to the --- line above its base-commit: or change-id: line, else up to its signature. Empty for a series whose first message is a patch

patches.description: How many patches the series has: the M of the N/M in the subject's prefixes; 1 without one
